Bug: the resize keeper stopped a phone's fling (a smooth scroll 800 → 3800 ended at 1138 when the height changed mid-scroll, as when the toolbar hides). fixed Only a change of width counts; nothing is put back while a scroll moves; the place is taken when a scroll comes to rest. Re-measured: the fling ends at 3800; a jump to the top then a resize stays at 0.

Bug: keyboard focus gone from text fields (the footer's email, the checkout's fields). fixed The ring is drawn while the keyboard is in use (html[data-keyed], scripts/focus.js); a click still shows the caret only. Re-measured: border ink-20 after a click, full ink after Tab.
Bug: the cross or Esc pressed while the modal's text was changing was ignored. fixed step() closes when asked meanwhile. Re-measured: closed 1.6s after «next» + cross.
Bug: the roast note was a black box on the faded ground. fixed No ground of its own: it takes the place of the digits and the caption (they go invisible under it).
Bug: a footer hairline crossed into the brand square at L (36px at 1024). fixed The left groups of the right half do not run out. Re-measured: the line starts at 512, the half's edge.
Bug: the hero title shrank as the frame came in (102px at 1612, 91.6 at 1614). fixed Capped at its size at the column's 1520px: 90px from about 1500 on, never less.

Bug: recommended cards stayed visible outside the column while sliding (and after a part-way swipe). fixed A card leaves as soon as it starts to slide out, fading on ease-out; one entering shows from half in. Re-measured: after a 180px swipe the card 180px out is at opacity 0; no card shows beyond the column at rest.
Mismatch: the note was 14–16px (type-body). fixed max(16px, var(--type-body)): 16px at every size.

Mismatch: below ~1366 the hero's rows set the height, not the title (275 vs a 241px title at 1024). kept · for Tim There the countdown's digits (82px tall) need more than a third of the title; making the title lead would mean shrinking the digits or growing the title past its cell.
Mismatch: «обжарки» ran 3–5px into the padding (4.5em was short). fixed 4.55em, measured: 0.6px at most.
Mismatch: the step row 64.6px, not 66. fixed The comment now says 65px at 1440 (Figma 66): 24px + the 16px text's line + 24px.

Mismatch: navbar hover areas uneven (3px right of «Кофе» lit «Каскара»). fixed The tint is a ::before 6px wider than the link and ignores the pointer; the links' boxes meet mid-gap. Re-measured: 2px past «Кофе» is «Кофе», mid-gap ±1px splits.
Mismatch: the taste cell uneven at 1024 (20 above, 43 below: the pills make the box taller). fixed The chart is centred: 27 / 27.

Polish: text on the business cards now sits on a thinner part of the fade (offer titles at 33–38% black; 2.4:1 against the lightest pixel). kept · for Tim The trade-off of a fade over the whole block; the fade tuner can set a curve that is darker sooner, or a reach under 1.
Polish: the leaving card's pack was carried and tilted. fixed It goes upright, without a trail.
Polish: the place was taken on every scroll frame (up to 46 lookups). fixed Once, when a scroll comes to rest.
Polish: leftovers in home.css (two .fmodal__body rules, blank lines). fixed
